# meca-antorchas-ganon (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F7, Castillo de Ganon), A: both ADULT at the entrance; the torch rooms: room 08's candles lit and its shutter's played event, room 02's candle; a player's own reset record of room 08 never.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by
# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:
# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.
# Mutant: the same run without LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS turns the 'never' lines of the adult list red.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 20-ganon
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 226
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test flag InsideGanonCastle_Room08_Candle_ON \(0x8aa0ccd0\) = 1: queued within enciende..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x8aa0ccd0 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within enciende..end
#! expect A coop: test flag HavePlayedEvent\.InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_ShutterOpen_08_01 \(0x60ad7b07\) = 1: queued within abierta..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x60ad7b07 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within abierta..end
#! expect A coop: test flag InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_Room02_CandleStick \(0xfc09191a\) = 1: queued within enciende2..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0xfc09191a \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within enciende2..end
#! expect A coop: test flag InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_Room08_CandleWasReset \(0xe5ba1fc5\) = 1: queued within reinicia..end
#! never B coop: flags debug: bool 0xe5ba1fc5 
mark start
warp InsideGanonCastle Entrance adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark enciende
flag InsideGanonCastle_Room08_Candle_ON 1
wait 300
mark abierta
flag HavePlayedEvent.InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_ShutterOpen_08_01 1
wait 300
mark enciende2
flag InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_Room02_CandleStick 1
wait 300
mark reinicia
flag InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_Room08_CandleWasReset 1   # a player's own: never shared
wait 300
wait 300
mark end
